agents.name: tester
agents.command: Write-Output ('TEST task=' + $env:FLEET_TASK); if (Test-Path package.json) { npm test } elseif (Test-Path Makefile) { make test } else { Write-Output 'No test runner configured.' }

agents.name: reviewer
agents.command: Write-Output ('REVIEW task=' + $env:FLEET_TASK); git --no-pager diff --stat; git --no-pager diff --check
